description: This file defines a utility class 'CacheUtils' for interacting with cache storage, including methods for adding, retrieving, and removing cache entries, as well as retrieving cache keys for a specific merchant store.

classes.name: CacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class for cache operations, including put, get, remove, and managing cache keys related to MerchantStore.

methods.name: putInCache
methods.description: Stores an object in the cache with a specified key.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache using the specified key.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Fetches a list of cache keys associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: shutDownCache
methods.description: Placeholder for cache shutdown logic (currently does nothing).

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry by key.

methods.name: removeAllFromCache
methods.description: Removes all cache entries associated with a specific MerchantStore.
